title: Chief Commissioner's Powers of General Superintendence

content.scenario: The Chief Commissioner of the Central Authority needs to delegate some of his powers to a Commissioner of a regional office to ensure efficient administration of the Authority.
content.outcome: The Chief Commissioner has the power to delegate his powers relating to administrative matters of the Central Authority to any Commissioner (including Commissioner of a regional office) or any other officer of the Central Authority, as he may think fit.

user_queries: What are the powers of the Chief Commissioner?
Can the Chief Commissioner delegate his powers?
How does the Chief Commissioner exercise his powers of general superintendence?
